metadata.description:
The proposed mega project on the Great Nicobar Island in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands is once again in the spotlight. Will this project strengthen India’s economy and strategic position, or will it come at the cost of the environment and the rights of indigenous communities?

In this video, we discuss the newly proposed additions to the Great Nicobar Project, including an international cruise terminal, high-end tourism infrastructure, shipbuilding and shipbreaking facilities, and more. While the government claims that this project is crucial for India’s trade and national security, experts and environmentalists warn of irreversible damage to the island’s forests, biodiversity, and vulnerable tribal groups like the Shompen.

Watch the full video to understand the project's impact on the environment and the local communities, and share your thoughts in the comments below.
